scene: The sugar elevator shoots up to the foundry roof depot.
picture: Flat side view. On the factory rooftop deck, the South Asian girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair on the far left. Left, a yellow delivery truck rests with an open ramp. Centre, a transparent elevator tube glimmers with buttons. Right, a brass airship is moored to a post.
shown: A yellow delivery truck sits idling with its ramp down on the left.
A towering glass elevator tube stands with glowing buttons in the centre.
A striped brass airship bobs at a mooring post on the right.

variants.scene: Cool evening air greets you on the busy brick rooftop depot.
A bronze zeppelin hums beside the glass tube under purple clouds.
You arrive on the high roof, still searching for {quest}.
